name: glide
label: Glide
description: Manage Glide Big Tables and rows with Glide’s API.

token.label: Secret Token
token.description:
To get your token:
1. Open Glide and go to the **Data** editor.
2. Open a Big Table and click **Show API**.
3. Copy the **secret token** shown in the API details.
4. Paste it below.

This piece uses Glide's Big Tables API, so the available actions work with Big Tables only.

get-rows.label: Get Rows
get-rows.description: Retrieve rows from a Glide Big Table.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: Select the Glide Big Table to use.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

list-tables.label: List Tables
list-tables.description: List the Glide Big Tables available to the authenticated team.
